content.goal: AI Job Search is an AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code. It turns Claude Code into a job application assistant that evaluates job postings, drafts tailored CVs and cover letters, and preps users for interviews, with a core workflow described as language- and country-agnostic.
content.usage: Users fork and clone the repository with `gh repo fork MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search --clone`, install the job-portal CLI tools via `python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py`, then run `claude` and use the `/setup`, `/scrape`, and `/apply` commands inside Claude Code to build a profile, search job portals, and generate tailored application materials.
content.pros: According to the documentation, the `/apply` workflow includes a PDF verification loop that compiles and visually inspects generated CVs and cover letters, an ATS check that verifies the PDF's extracted text layer, and a drafter-reviewer separation where a second agent critiques drafts before revision.
content.cons: Claude Code has no free tier, so use requires a Claude Pro/Max/Team subscription or pay-per-token Anthropic API credits; the documentation also notes that forks of the repository are always public, which may affect how personal profile data is stored.
content.fit: The core evaluation and application pipeline is described as language- and country-agnostic, but the shipped job-portal search skills target the Danish market, suggesting this may best fit users willing to adapt or add portal skills for other countries.

ko.pros: 문서에 따르면 `/apply` 워크플로우에는 생성된 CV와 커버레터를 컴파일하고 시각적으로 검사하는 PDF 검증 루프, PDF 텍스트 레이어를 확인하는 ATS 검사, 그리고 초안 작성 후 별도 에이전트가 검토하는 드래프터-리뷰어 구조가 포함되어 있습니다.

zh-CN.usage: 用户可使用 `gh repo fork MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search --clone` 命令 fork 并克隆该仓库，通过 `python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py` 安装招聘门户 CLI 工具,然后运行 `claude`,并在 Claude Code 中使用 `/setup`、`/scrape` 和 `/apply` 命令建立档案、搜索职位并生成定制申请材料。
zh-CN.pros: 文档说明 `/apply` 工作流程包含一个 PDF 校验循环，会编译并目视检查生成的简历和求职信，还包含一个检查 PDF 文本层的 ATS 校验，以及起草者与审阅者分离的机制，由第二个代理在修订前对草稿进行评审。
zh-CN.cons: Claude Code 没有免费套餐，因此使用该框架需要 Claude Pro/Max/Team 订阅，或按 token 计费的 Anthropic API 额度；文档还指出该仓库的 fork 始终是公开的，这似乎可能影响个人资料数据的存储方式。

es.goal: AI Job Search es un framework de búsqueda de empleo impulsado por IA, construido sobre Claude Code. Su flujo de trabajo principal, descrito como independiente del idioma y del país, evalúa ofertas de empleo, redacta CVs y cartas de presentación personalizadas, y prepara a los usuarios para entrevistas.
es.usage: Los usuarios bifurcan y clonan el repositorio con `gh repo fork MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search --clone`, instalan las herramientas CLI de los portales de empleo mediante `python3 tools/install_portal_clis.py`, luego ejecutan `claude` y usan los comandos `/setup`, `/scrape` y `/apply` dentro de Claude Code para crear un perfil, buscar ofertas y generar materiales de solicitud personalizados.
es.pros: Según la documentación, el flujo `/apply` incluye un bucle de verificación de PDF que compila e inspecciona visualmente el CV y la carta generados, una comprobación ATS que revisa la capa de texto del PDF, y una separación entre redactor y revisor en la que un segundo agente critica los borradores antes de revisarlos.
es.cons: Claude Code no tiene nivel gratuito, por lo que su uso requiere una suscripción Pro/Max/Team o créditos de la API de Anthropic facturados por token; la documentación también señala que los forks de este repositorio son siempre públicos, lo que podría afectar cómo se almacenan los datos personales del perfil.
es.fit: El flujo principal de evaluación y solicitud se describe como independiente del idioma y del país, pero las habilidades de búsqueda en portales incluidas están orientadas al mercado danés, por lo que podría encajar mejor en usuarios dispuestos a adaptar o añadir sus propias integraciones de portales.

content.goal: This repository, anthropics/claude-plugins-official, is a curated directory of plugins for Claude Code, split into internally maintained plugins in /plugins and third-party plugins in /external_plugins.
content.usage: Plugins are installed directly from this marketplace via Claude Code's plugin system, for example by running `/plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official`, or by browsing entries through `/plugin > Discover`.
content.pros: Each plugin follows a standard layout with a required plugin.json manifest plus optional .mcp.json configuration, commands, agents, and skills directories, and a plugin's `name` slug is treated as immutable so renames don't break existing installs.
content.cons: The README states that Anthropic does not control the MCP servers, files, or other software bundled inside plugins and cannot verify they work as intended or won't change, so users are advised to trust a plugin before installing, updating, or using it.
content.fit: The directory appears geared toward Claude Code users wanting a centralized way to find and install plugins, though the explicit trust-and-verification caveat suggests it may suit users comfortable independently vetting third-party plugin content.

content.goal: OpenCode is described as an open source AI coding agent, available through a command-line interface and a desktop application (currently in BETA).
content.usage: It can be installed with `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` or via package managers such as `npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest`, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, mise, or Nix. The desktop app can be downloaded from https://opencode.ai/download. Within the tool, users switch between the built-in build and plan agents using the Tab key.
content.pros: OpenCode ships with two built-in agents: build, a default full-access agent for development work, and plan, a read-only agent for codebase analysis that denies file edits by default and asks permission before running bash commands. A general subagent is also included for complex, multistep searches.
content.cons: The desktop application is explicitly labeled BETA, and the README advises removing versions older than 0.1.x before installing, suggesting past releases may have had compatibility issues.
content.fit: Given its CLI-first installation options and a read-only plan agent aimed at exploring unfamiliar codebases, OpenCode appears best suited to developers who want an AI coding assistant integrated into terminal or desktop workflows, though the README does not specify minimum system requirements.

es.goal: OpenCode se describe como un agente de codificación de IA de código abierto, disponible mediante una interfaz de línea de comandos y una aplicación de escritorio (actualmente en BETA).
es.usage: Se puede instalar con el comando `curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/install | bash` o mediante gestores de paquetes como `npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest`, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, mise o Nix. La aplicación de escritorio puede descargarse desde https://opencode.ai/download. Dentro de la herramienta, se cambia entre los agentes integrados build y plan con la tecla Tab.
es.pros: OpenCode incluye dos agentes integrados: build, el agente predeterminado con acceso completo para tareas de desarrollo, y plan, un agente de solo lectura que deniega ediciones de archivos por defecto y solicita permiso antes de ejecutar comandos bash. También incluye un subagente general para búsquedas complejas de varios pasos.
es.cons: La aplicación de escritorio está marcada explícitamente como BETA, y la documentación recomienda eliminar versiones anteriores a 0.1.x antes de instalar, lo que sugiere que pudo haber problemas de compatibilidad entre versiones anteriores.
es.fit: Dadas sus opciones de instalación centradas en la línea de comandos y un agente plan de solo lectura orientado a explorar bases de código desconocidas, OpenCode parece adecuado para desarrolladores que desean integrar un asistente de codificación de IA en flujos de trabajo de terminal o escritorio, aunque la documentación no especifica requisitos mínimos del sistema.

ja.goal: OpenCodeはオープンソースのAIコーディングエージェントとして紹介されており、コマンドラインインターフェースと現在BETA版のデスクトップアプリケーションの両方で利用できます。

content.goal: Cursor/plugins is a repository of official Cursor plugins for developer tools, frameworks, and SaaS products. Each plugin lives in its own directory with a `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json` manifest, covering areas like developer tooling, productivity, and third-party integrations such as GitHub, Gmail, and Salesforce.
content.usage: The repo is organized as a multi-plugin marketplace. A root `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json` lists every plugin, while each plugin folder has its own `plugin.json`, plus optional `skills/`, `rules/`, `mcp.json`, `README.md`, and `CHANGELOG.md` files.
content.pros: The catalog spans many categories—Developer Tools, Productivity, and Integrations—including GitHub, Playwright, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Workspace apps, and numerous finance and trading platforms, offering broad ready-made coverage for connecting Cursor agents to external services.
content.cons: Several finance- and commerce-related plugins, such as Robinhood, Coinbase, eToro Trading, and Gopuff, appear to require signing in with one's own external account, which suggests that actions like trades or orders placed through them would affect the user's real account.
content.fit: This repository seems best suited to developers already using Cursor who want to extend it with pre-built skills, rules, and MCP integrations for common SaaS platforms, rather than those seeking a standalone tool outside the Cursor ecosystem.

content.goal: Ruflo presents itself as an agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex, adding 100+ specialized agents, swarm coordination, self-learning memory, and federated agent communication across machines.
content.usage: Install it as a Claude Code plugin by running `/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo` followed by `/plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo` (Claude Code 2.1.287 or later is required), or run `npx ruflo@latest init wizard` for the full CLI install with its own MCP server.
content.pros: The documentation describes two install paths: a lightweight Claude Code plugin offering only slash commands, and a full CLI install that adds 98 agents, 60+ commands, and 30 skills along with an MCP server, hooks, and a daemon.
content.cons: Mods are described as running with the installer's account permissions without sandboxing, making code review before installation a documented precaution. Vector memory (HNSW-indexed AgentDB) is reported to tie or lose to brute-force search at small dataset sizes, showing a measured speed advantage only above a stated crossover point.
content.fit: Because it depends on Claude Code at version 2.1.287 or later, or another MCP-enabled client such as Codex, Ruflo likely suits developers already working with those specific tools who want added orchestration and memory features; it may be less relevant without one of those hosts.

ko.pros: 문서는 두 가지 설치 경로를 설명합니다: 슬래시 명령만 제공하는 경량 Claude Code 플러그인, 그리고 98개 에이전트, 60개 이상의 명령, 30개 스킬과 함께 MCP 서버, 훅, 데몬을 추가하는 전체 CLI 설치입니다.
ko.cons: mods는 설치자의 계정 권한으로 샌드박스 없이 실행된다고 설명되어 있어, 설치 전 코드 검토가 문서화된 주의사항입니다. 또한 HNSW 기반 AgentDB 벡터 메모리는 작은 데이터셋에서는 무차별 탐색과 동등하거나 느리며, 명시된 교차점 이상에서만 측정된 속도 우위를 보인다고 보고됩니다.

zh-CN.usage: 作为 Claude Code 插件安装时，先运行 `/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo`，再运行 `/plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo`（需要 Claude Code 2.1.287 或更高版本）；若需要完整 CLI 安装并自带 MCP 服务器，可运行 `npx ruflo@latest init wizard`。
zh-CN.pros: 文档描述了两种安装路径：仅提供斜杠命令的轻量级 Claude Code 插件，以及包含 98 个智能体、60 多个命令、30 个技能，并附带 MCP 服务器、钩子和守护进程的完整 CLI 安装。
zh-CN.cons: 文档说明 mods 以安装者的账户权限运行且未进行沙箱隔离，因此在安装前审查其代码是文档中提到的预防措施。另外，基于 HNSW 索引的 AgentDB 向量内存据报告在小数据集规模下与暴力搜索持平或更慢，只有超过文档所述的交叉点后才表现出测得的速度优势。
zh-CN.fit: 由于其依赖 Claude Code（需 2.1.287 或更高版本）或如 Codex 等支持 MCP 的客户端，Ruflo 可能更适合已经使用这些特定代理工具、并希望获得额外编排与记忆功能的开发者；若没有这些宿主环境，其适用性可能会降低。

es.goal: Ruflo se presenta como un meta-harness de agentes para Claude Code y Codex, que según la documentación añade más de 100 agentes especializados, coordinación de enjambres, memoria de autoaprendizaje y comunicación federada entre máquinas.
es.usage: Para instalarlo como plugin de Claude Code, ejecute `/plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo` y luego `/plugin install ruflo-core@ruflo` (requiere Claude Code 2.1.287 o posterior), o ejecute `npx ruflo@latest init wizard` para la instalación completa por CLI con su propio servidor MCP.
es.pros: La documentación describe dos rutas de instalación: un plugin ligero de Claude Code con solo comandos de barra, y una instalación completa por CLI que añade 98 agentes, más de 60 comandos y 30 habilidades junto con un servidor MCP, hooks y un daemon.
es.cons: Se indica que los mods se ejecutan con los permisos de la cuenta del usuario sin aislamiento (sandboxing), por lo que revisar su código antes de instalarlos es una precaución documentada. Además, la memoria vectorial (AgentDB indexada con HNSW) reportadamente iguala o pierde frente a la búsqueda por fuerza bruta en conjuntos de datos pequeños, mostrando una ventaja de velocidad medida solo por encima de un punto de cruce indicado.
es.fit: Debido a su dependencia de Claude Code (versión 2.1.287 o posterior) o de otro cliente compatible con MCP como Codex, Ruflo probablemente resulte adecuado para desarrolladores que ya trabajan con esas herramientas específicas y buscan funciones adicionales de orquestación y memoria; podría ser menos relevante sin alguno de esos entornos.

content.goal: ai-memory is a tool that gives AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor) a shared, persistent memory so work can continue across agents, sessions, and machines without re-explaining context.
content.usage: Install with `curl -fsSL https://github.com/akitaonrails/ai-memory/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` then run `ai-memory setup` to configure a per-user service and wire supported agents; a Docker image and NixOS module are also documented.
content.pros: Memory is stored as git-backed markdown files that can be grepped or edited by hand, works with zero LLM calls by default for capture, search, and handoffs, and is shared across more than twenty supported agent harnesses.
content.cons: Native Windows support is listed as Experimental rather than fully supported, so users on that platform may encounter limitations compared to Linux, macOS, or WSL2 installs.
content.fit: Built as a single Rust binary (requiring Rust 1.95+ to build) under the MIT license, ai-memory appears best suited to individual developers or small teams willing to self-host a memory server rather than rely on a managed cloud service.

content.goal: Orca is described as an AI orchestrator desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that runs multiple CLI coding agents (such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or Pi) side by side, each in its own git worktree, tracked from one interface.
content.usage: Install via https://onorca.dev/download, or on macOS via `brew install --cask stablyai/orca/orca`, or on Arch Linux via `yay -S stably-orca-bin`. An Orca CLI is also mentioned, with commands like `orca worktree create`, `snapshot`, `click`, and `fill` for scripting workflows; a mobile companion app pairs with the desktop app for monitoring agents.
content.pros: Listed features include parallel worktrees for comparing agent outputs, terminal splits, a Design Mode for sending UI elements to agent prompts, native GitHub and Linear browsing, SSH-based remote worktrees, and diff annotation for reviewing agent changes.
content.cons: The README notes its feature list is perpetually behind actual shipped updates, so users may need to check the linked GitHub releases for capabilities beyond what is documented, and no minimum system requirements are given for the desktop app.
content.fit: Based on the described feature set, Orca appears suited for developers coordinating multiple AI coding agents across isolated worktrees, though the README does not specify minimum system requirements or agent-specific configuration details.

content.goal: CLI-Anything is a toolkit that generates command-line interfaces for existing software so AI agents can operate it through structured commands, and CLI-Hub is a companion registry for browsing and installing community-built CLIs.
content.usage: Install the registry client with `pip install cli-anything-hub` and then `cli-hub install <name>` to use existing CLIs. To build a new CLI, add the Claude Code plugin with `/plugin marketplace add HKUDS/CLI-Anything` and `/plugin install cli-anything`, then run `/cli-anything ./gimp` to generate a harness through a 7-phase pipeline.
content.pros: The README reports 2,461 passing tests across supported applications, documents integration with multiple agent platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw, and the project is released under the Apache 2.0 license.
content.cons: The documented limitations state that reliable CLI generation depends on frontier-class models such as Claude Opus 4.6 or GPT-5.4, so weaker models may produce incomplete or incorrect CLIs that likely require manual correction.
content.fit: Given the stated prerequisites of Python 3.10+, locally or online available target source code, and a supported AI coding agent, this tool seems best suited to teams with accessible codebases seeking agent-controllable CLIs, rather than closed-source or binary-only software.

es.pros: El README informa 2.461 pruebas superadas en las aplicaciones soportadas, documenta integración con varias plataformas de agentes como Claude Code, Cursor y OpenClaw, y el proyecto se distribuye bajo licencia Apache 2.0.
es.cons: Las limitaciones documentadas indican que la generación confiable de CLIs depende de modelos de vanguardia como Claude Opus 4.6 o GPT-5.4, por lo que modelos más débiles podrían producir CLIs incompletas o incorrectas que probablemente requieran corrección manual.
es.fit: Dados los requisitos indicados —Python 3.10+, código fuente del objetivo disponible localmente o en línea, y un agente de codificación de IA compatible— esta herramienta parece más adecuada para equipos con bases de código accesibles que buscan CLIs controlables por agentes, en lugar de software de código cerrado o solo binario.

content.goal: VoiceStudio is an open-source tool for voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages, using k2-fsa/OmniVoice as its default engine, with other engines selectable.
content.usage: Install on macOS/Linux with `curl -fsSL https://voicestudio.sh/install | sh`, or on Windows via PowerShell. To run from source, clone with `git clone https://github.com/debpalash/VoiceStudio.git`, run `bun install`, prepare Python dependencies, then run `bun run dev`.
content.pros: The app supports local-only workflows that avoid remote services, includes a local API and MCP integration for connecting agents, and offers hardware acceleration through CUDA on NVIDIA GPUs or Metal/MPS on Apple Silicon.
content.cons: Building the current main branch requires Git, Node.js 22+, Bun, Rust/Cargo, and platform build tools, which likely raises setup effort for contributors compared to installing a packaged release.
content.fit: Electron is documented as the only supported desktop app and web UI, since the Tauri shell was retired after version 0.5.3 under the AGPL-3.0 license, so this likely suits users willing to migrate away from older Tauri-based installs.

content.goal: Android skills is a repository of AI-optimized, modular markdown instructions (SKILL.md files) that follow the open-standard agent skills format, grounding LLMs with Android development guidance sourced from developer.android.com. Development focuses on use cases where evaluations show LLMs underperform, rather than duplicating areas like basic Jetpack Compose where LLMs are already proficient.
content.usage: Skills are installed via the Android CLI, e.g. `android skills add r8-analyzer --project=.` for a single skill or `android skills add --all` for all skills, and updated with `android skills update --all`. The repository can also be installed as an agent plugin, for example `/plugin install android-skills --marketplace android/skills` in Claude Code; installed skills are activated automatically by the agent when a relevant task is requested.
content.pros: Skills are modular and prioritize domains where LLMs reportedly underperform rather than duplicating well-covered basics. Installation is supported for multiple agents (Gemini, Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex), and the project is licensed under Apache License 2.0.
content.cons: Public contributions are not currently accepted, limiting external collaboration to issue submissions. The documentation also states that AI can make mistakes and results should always be double-checked, suggesting skill outputs may still require manual verification.
content.fit: This repository appears suited for teams using Android CLI-compatible agents (Gemini, Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex) for targeted Android development guidance, and less suited for generic tasks where LLMs are already proficient, such as basic Jetpack Compose patterns.

Several notebooks, such as the LLM AutoEval notebook in the Tools table, carry an 'Open In Colab' badge, so they may be opened and run directly in Google Colab without local installation. content.fit: This resource appears best suited to individuals self-studying LLM theory, fine-tuning, and deployment practices, rather than teams looking for a production-ready software library.

content.goal: Jasna is a free tool that restores (removes) mosaics in videos and images, offered as both a GUI app and a command line, running on the GPU.
content.usage: Download the release for your system, unpack it into a path without non-English characters, then run the executable (e.g. jasna.exe) or use the command line, such as `jasna --input input.mp4 --output output.mkv`. The first job takes about 15–60 minutes while models are prepared for your GPU.
content.pros: Offers two restoration models — the free, fast BasicVSR++ and the slower, more detailed LTX for supporters — plus a Segment Editor preview and a live Video Player that previews without creating a file. Benchmarks show restoration notably faster than a comparable tool (Lada) on an RTX 5090.
content.cons: Requires a supported NVIDIA GPU (GTX 16-series/RTX 20-series or newer) or an experimental AMD GPU; older GTX 10-series cards don't work. Install paths can't contain non-English characters, network disks aren't supported, and the first run needs a one-time 15–60 minute model preparation step.
content.fit: Jasna appears best suited for users with a compatible GPU who want free mosaic removal from media, with optional paid supporter tiers ($15 USD or $25 USD) unlocking additional models like LTX; a License code activates on up to 3 PCs or cloud workspaces.

El primer trabajo tarda entre 15 y 60 minutos mientras se preparan los modelos para su GPU.

content.goal: ComfyUI is presented as an AI engine for visual content creation, offering a modular node-graph interface to build workflows that generate images, video, 3D models, and audio. It is described as natively supporting a range of open-source diffusion models, with some closed-source models reachable through partner nodes.
content.usage: ComfyUI can be installed via the desktop app (https://www.comfy.org/download), a Windows portable build, manual git clone, or comfy-cli (`pip install comfy-cli` then `comfy install`), and is started with `python main.py`.
content.pros: The documentation describes efficient local execution features such as asynchronous queueing and VRAM/RAM management, and states that large models can run with as little as 4GB VRAM and 8GB RAM. It can reportedly run fully offline unless optional paid API nodes are enabled.
content.cons: Python 3.14 is noted to work but may cause issues with some custom nodes, and torch 2.7 is described as only minimally supported, with newer versions recommended, suggesting dependency version management may need attention.
content.fit: Given its desktop app, portable build, manual install path, and optional paid cloud offering, ComfyUI appears suited both to new users wanting a simple setup and to advanced users needing fine-grained local control across Windows, Linux, and macOS.

La documentación indica soporte nativo para varios modelos de difusión de código abierto, con acceso a algunos modelos de código cerrado mediante nodos asociados.
es.usage: Puede instalarse mediante la aplicación de escritorio (https://www.comfy.org/download), una compilación portátil para Windows, clonación manual del repositorio, o comfy-cli (`pip install comfy-cli` seguido de `comfy install`), y se ejecuta con `python main.py`.
es.pros: La documentación describe funciones de ejecución local eficiente, como colas asíncronas y gestión de VRAM/RAM, e indica que es posible ejecutar modelos grandes con tan solo 4GB de VRAM y 8GB de RAM. Según se señala, puede funcionar completamente sin conexión salvo que se habiliten nodos de API opcionales de pago.
es.cons: Se indica que Python 3.14 funciona pero puede causar problemas en algunos nodos personalizados, y que torch 2.7 cuenta solo con soporte mínimo, recomendándose versiones más recientes, lo que sugiere que la gestión de versiones de dependencias podría requerir atención.
es.fit: Dado que ofrece aplicación de escritorio, compilación portátil, instalación manual y una opción de nube de pago, ComfyUI parece adecuado tanto para usuarios nuevos que buscan una configuración sencilla como para usuarios avanzados que necesitan control local detallado en Windows, Linux y macOS.

ja.fit: デスクトップアプリ、ポータブル版、手動インストール、有料クラウドオプションが用意されていることから、ComfyUIは簡単な導入を望む新規ユーザーと、Windows・Linux・macOS上でローカル実行を細かく制御したい上級ユーザーの両方に適している可能性があります。

content.goal: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an MCP server and CLI that lets a coding agent reverse engineer native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, websites, and other target types to explain how a feature works, down to the binary level, with supporting evidence.
content.usage: Install and register with an agent via `npx rea-agents setup`, which adds REA's MCP server and workflow instructions for supported agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Grok Build). The CLI can also be used directly, e.g. `npm install --global rea-agents` followed by `rea --help`.
content.pros: Analysis runs locally, and returned findings include evidence and stated limitations. REA covers many target types out of the box, including Go and Rust binaries, WASM, EVM bytecode, SQLite databases, and JavaScript/Electron apps, several without needing a separate native analysis engine.
content.cons: Deep native-binary analysis depends on having an existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installation (Hopper can optionally be installed by setup with approval); these appear to be separately licensed commercial tools that REA itself does not provide. Certain Linux workflows also require a procps-compatible `ps` on PATH.
content.fit: Based on its stated purpose, REA appears suited to developers and researchers doing lawful reverse engineering, interoperability work, or software preservation on code they own or are authorized to examine, and requires Node.js 22.19+, 24.11+, or 26+ with npm.

es.fit: Según el propósito declarado, REA parece adecuado para desarrolladores e investigadores que realizan ingeniería inversa legal, trabajo de interoperabilidad o preservación de software sobre código que poseen o están autorizados a examinar, y requiere Node.js 22.19+, 24.11+ o 26+ junto con npm.

A source build, which also covers Linux, follows the steps in _docs/dev_setup.md and produces the desktop application via the scripts in ./script/artcraft.

content.goal: AnyPS5 is described as a tool for automatically porting executables to Linux and Windows, apparently centered on PS5 executables given its relinker and system library components; it includes a relinker that converts executables to the target system's native format plus implementations of system prx libraries for dynamic linking, without emulation or a separate runtime process.
content.usage: Users can try a web-based converter where files stay on the user's device, or build the project locally following separately documented build instructions. Controller input uses SDL mapping, while keyboard and mouse controls can be configured via an anyps5-input.ini file.

content.goal: Context Mode is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI coding agents that addresses context-window consumption from two sides: raw tool output flooding the context window, and lost session state when a conversation compacts. It runs tool output through sandboxed execution and indexes content into a local SQLite FTS5 knowledge base so only relevant results enter context.
content.usage: For Claude Code, install with `/plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode` followed by `/plugin install context-mode@context-mode`, restart, then verify with `/context-mode:ctx-doctor`. Other documented clients install via `npm install -g context-mode` plus client-specific MCP/hook configuration. Typing `ctx stats` inside a session shows context savings.
content.pros: The README reports up to 98% context-size reduction in example scenarios, such as 315 KB of raw session output reduced to roughly 5.4 KB, and a 56 KB Playwright snapshot reduced to under 300 bytes. It states no telemetry, cloud sync, or account requirement, with session data kept in local SQLite files.
content.cons: Automatic routing enforcement depends on hook support, which the README says varies by platform; platforms without hooks, such as Zed and Antigravity IDE, rely on manually copied instruction files with a documented ~60% compliance rate versus ~98% with hooks enabled. On Linux, Node.js versions below 22.5 are stated as unsupported.
content.fit: This appears suited to developers using MCP-compatible AI coding agents who want to cut token usage from large tool outputs and preserve task/file state across context compaction. The Elastic License 2.0 allows self-use, forking, and modification but, per the README, disallows offering it as a hosted or managed service.

zh-CN.goal: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编程代理的 MCP(Model Context Protocol)服务器,从两个方面解决上下文窗口消耗问题:原始工具输出淹没上下文窗口,以及对话压缩时会话状态丢失。它通过沙箱执行处理工具输出,并将内容索引到本地 SQLite FTS5 知识库中,使只有相关结果进入上下文。
zh-CN.usage: 在 Claude Code 中,先执行 `/plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode`,再执行 `/plugin install context-mode@context-mode`,重启后用 `/context-mode:ctx-doctor` 验证。其他文档化的客户端通过 `npm install -g context-mode` 加上特定客户端的 MCP/钩子配置来安装。在会话中输入 `ctx stats` 可查看节省的上下文量。
zh-CN.pros: README 报告在示例场景中上下文大小最多减少 98%,例如 315 KB 的原始会话输出被压缩到约 5.4 KB,56 KB 的 Playwright 快照被压缩到不足 300 字节。文档声明没有遥测、云同步或账户要求,会话数据保存在本地 SQLite 文件中。

es.goal: Context Mode es un servidor MCP (Model Context Protocol) para agentes de codificación con IA que aborda el consumo de la ventana de contexto desde dos frentes: la salida bruta de herramientas que inunda la ventana de contexto, y la pérdida del estado de la sesión cuando una conversación se compacta. Procesa la salida de herramientas mediante ejecución en sandbox e indexa el contenido en una base de conocimiento SQLite FTS5 local, de modo que solo los resultados relevantes entran al contexto.
es.usage: Para Claude Code, instale con `/plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode` seguido de `/plugin install context-mode@context-mode`, reinicie y verifique con `/context-mode:ctx-doctor`. Otros clientes documentados se instalan vía `npm install -g context-mode` más configuración de MCP/hooks específica del cliente. Escribir `ctx stats` dentro de una sesión muestra el ahorro de contexto.
es.pros: El README reporta una reducción del tamaño de contexto de hasta el 98% en escenarios de ejemplo, como 315 KB de salida bruta de sesión reducidos a aproximadamente 5.4 KB, y una captura de Playwright de 56 KB reducida a menos de 300 bytes. Se indica que no hay telemetría, sincronización en la nube ni cuenta requerida, y que los datos de sesión se mantienen en archivos SQLite locales.
es.cons: La aplicación automática de enrutamiento depende del soporte de hooks, lo cual el README indica que varía según la plataforma; las plataformas sin hooks, como Zed y Antigravity IDE, dependen de archivos de instrucciones copiados manualmente con una tasa de cumplimiento documentada de ~60% frente a ~98% con hooks habilitados. En Linux, se indica que las versiones de Node.js inferiores a 22.5 no son compatibles.
es.fit: Parece adecuado para desarrolladores que usan agentes de codificación con IA compatibles con MCP y que desean reducir el consumo de tokens por salidas grandes de herramientas y preservar el estado de tareas/archivos tras la compactación del contexto. La Elastic License 2.0 permite el uso propio, la bifurcación y la modificación, pero, según el README, prohíbe ofrecerlo como servicio alojado o gestionado.

ja.goal: Context ModeはAIコーディングエージェント向けのMCP(Model Context Protocol)サーバーで、コンテキストウィンドウの消耗を2つの側面から解決します。生のツール出力がコンテキストウィンドウを圧迫する問題と、会話が圧縮された際にセッション状態が失われる問題です。ツール出力をサンドボックス実行で処理し、コンテンツをローカルのSQLite FTS5知識ベースにインデックス化することで、関連する結果のみがコンテキストに入るようにします。
ja.usage: Claude Codeでは、`/plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode`に続けて`/plugin install context-mode@context-mode`を実行し、再起動後`/context-mode:ctx-doctor`で確認します。その他のドキュメント化されたクライアントは、`npm install -g context-mode`とクライアント固有のMCP/フック設定でインストールします。セッション内で`ctx stats`と入力すると、節約されたコンテキストを確認できます。
ja.pros: READMEによると、例のシナリオで最大98%のコンテキストサイズ削減が報告されており、たとえば315 KBの生セッション出力が約5.4 KBに、56 KBのPlaywrightスナップショットが300バイト未満に削減されています。テレメトリ、クラウド同期、アカウント要件がなく、セッションデータはローカルのSQLiteファイルに保持されると記載されています。
ja.cons: 自動ルーティングの強制はフックのサポートに依存しており、READMEではこれがプラットフォームごとに異なると説明されています。フックをサポートしないプラットフォーム(ZedやAntigravity IDEなど)は手動でコピーする指示ファイルに依存し、フック有効時の約98%に対して約60%の遵守率が記載されています。Linuxでは、Node.js 22.5未満のバージョンはサポートされていないと記載されています。
ja.fit: MCP対応のAIコーディングエージェントを使用し、大量のツール出力によるトークン消費を抑えつつ、コンテキスト圧縮後もタスク/ファイルの状態を維持したい開発者に適しているようです。Elastic License 2.0は自己利用、フォーク、改変を許可していますが、READMEによればホスティングサービスや管理サービスとして提供することは禁止されています。

content.goal: Diagram Design is an Agent Skill that generates editorial-style diagrams as a single self-contained HTML + SVG file, covering 45 diagram types, intended for diagrams meant to be published rather than kept as editable, diffable source files.
content.usage: Install with `npx skills add cathrynlavery/diagram-design`, or in Claude Code via `/plugin marketplace add cathrynlavery/diagram-design` followed by `/plugin install diagram-design@diagram-design`; afterward, ask the connected agent in plain language to produce or redraw a diagram.
content.pros: It outputs one dependency-free HTML file with no build step, supports brand onboarding by extracting a site's palette and fonts, and can redraw existing Mermaid, draw.io, and Excalidraw diagrams into the same editorial style.
content.cons: The README states the output is not an editable source format, so there is no text to diff in a pull request and no canvas to drag shapes on, and it notes that output quality depends on the model running it, meaning the same prompt can lay out differently between runs.
content.fit: It appears best suited for one-off diagrams meant for publication (blogs, decks, docs) rather than diagrams that live in Git and change frequently, for which the README recommends Mermaid instead.

content.goal: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework created and maintained by the National Security Agency Research Directorate. It provides disassembly, assembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting across Windows, macOS, and Linux, and lets users develop their own extensions or scripts in Java or Python.
content.usage: To install a pre-built release, install JDK 25 64-bit, download a release file, extract it, and launch it with ./ghidraRun (ghidraRun.bat on Windows) or via PyGhidra with ./support/pyghidraRun. To build from source, clone the repository with git clone https://github.com/NationalSecurityAgency/ghidra.git and run gradle buildGhidra.
content.pros: The framework supports a wide variety of processor instruction sets and executable formats, can run in both user-interactive and automated modes, and can be extended with custom Java or Python scripts and extensions.
content.cons: The README documents known security vulnerabilities in certain versions of Ghidra, so the version and update status of a given installation likely matter before use.
content.fit: Given its origin in NSA's cybersecurity mission, Ghidra appears best suited for SRE analysts examining malicious code or researching vulnerabilities in networks and systems, though building it from source requires specific toolchain versions such as JDK 25, Gradle 9.1.0+, and Python3 3.9 to 3.15.

content.goal: HyperFrames is an open-source (Apache 2.0) framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via a CLI, through AI coding-agent skills, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
content.usage: Scaffold a project with `npx hyperframes init my-video`, then `cd my-video` and run `npx hyperframes preview` to preview in-browser or `npx hyperframes render` to produce an MP4. Claude Code users can instead run `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` and `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`. Requires Node.js 22+ and FFmpeg.
content.pros: Compositions are plain HTML with no React requirement or proprietary timeline format, the CLI is non-interactive by default for agent use, and rendering is deterministic (same input, same output) for CI and regression testing. There is no build step since an index.html composition plays as-is, animation is adapter-based (GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI), and licensing is Apache 2.0 with no per-render fees.
content.cons: Cloning the full repository for development requires installing Git LFS to fetch about 240 MB of golden regression-test .mp4 baseline files, an extra setup step beyond a plain git clone. Separately, a non-interactive skill install without the `--skill` flag installs all 21 published skills instead of just the core set.
content.fit: The project appears best suited to developers or teams building automated, agent-driven, or CI-integrated video pipelines who prefer authoring in HTML/CSS over React, since it is positioned as an alternative to Remotion's React-based model — though this suitability is a cautious inference rather than an explicit claim.

es.goal: HyperFrames es un framework de código abierto (Apache 2.0) que convierte HTML, CSS, medios y animaciones navegables (seekable) en vídeos MP4 deterministas. Se puede usar localmente mediante una CLI, a través de habilidades para agentes de codificación con IA, o como núcleo de renderizado detrás de flujos de creación alojados.
es.usage: Crea un proyecto con `npx hyperframes init my-video`, luego ejecuta `cd my-video` y usa `npx hyperframes preview` para previsualizar en el navegador o `npx hyperframes render` para generar un MP4. Los usuarios de Claude Code pueden ejecutar en su lugar `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` y `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes`. Requiere Node.js 22+ y FFmpeg.
es.pros: Las composiciones son HTML plano, sin necesidad de React ni un formato de línea de tiempo propietario; la CLI es no interactiva por defecto, lo que facilita su uso por agentes; el renderizado es determinista (misma entrada, misma salida), adecuado para CI y pruebas de regresión. No requiere paso de compilación, ya que un index.html se reproduce tal cual; admite animación basada en adaptadores (GSAP, CSS, Lottie, Three.js, Anime.js, WAAPI); y se licencia bajo Apache 2.0 sin tarifas por renderizado.
es.cons: Clonar el repositorio completo para desarrollo requiere instalar Git LFS para obtener unos 240 MB de archivos .mp4 de referencia para pruebas de regresión, un paso adicional más allá de un git clone normal. Además, una instalación de habilidades no interactiva sin la opción `--skill` instala las 21 habilidades publicadas en lugar de solo el conjunto principal.
es.fit: El proyecto parece más adecuado para desarrolladores o equipos que construyen flujos de vídeo automatizados, impulsados por agentes o integrados con CI, y que prefieren redactar en HTML/CSS antes que en React, ya que se posiciona como alternativa al modelo de autoría basado en React de Remotion; aun así, esta idoneidad es una inferencia cautelosa y no una afirmación explícita.

ja.goal: HyperFrames は、HTML、CSS、メディア、シーク可能なアニメーションを決定論的な MP4 動画に変換するオープンソース(Apache 2.0)フレームワークです。ローカル CLI、AI コーディングエージェント向けスキル、またはホスト型制作ワークフローの背後にあるレンダリングコアとして利用できます。
ja.usage: `npx hyperframes init my-video` でプロジェクトを作成し、`cd my-video` の後に `npx hyperframes preview` でブラウザ上にプレビューするか、`npx hyperframes render` で MP4 にレンダリングします。Claude Code ユーザーは代わりに `claude plugin marketplace add heygen-com/hyperframes` と `claude plugin install hyperframes@hyperframes` を実行できます。Node.js 22+ と FFmpeg が必要です。
ja.pros: 構成はプレーンな HTML で、React や独自のタイムライン形式を必要とせず、CLI はデフォルトで非対話式のためエージェントでの利用に向いています。レンダリングは決定論的(同じ入力なら同じ出力)で CI や回帰テストに適しており、index.html がそのまま再生されるためビルド手順が不要です。GSAP、CSS、Lottie、Three.js、Anime.js、WAAPI といったアダプターベースのアニメーションに対応し、Apache 2.0 ライセンスでレンダリングごとの課金もありません。
ja.cons: 開発用にリポジトリ全体をクローンするには、約 240 MB のゴールデン回帰テスト用 .mp4 基準ファイルを取得するために Git LFS のインストールが必要で、通常の git clone に加えた追加準備が必要です。また、`--skill` オプションを指定しない非対話的なスキルインストールでは、コアセットだけでなく公開されている 21 個のスキルすべてがインストールされます。
ja.fit: このプロジェクトは、React よりも HTML/CSS での記述を好み、自動化された、エージェント主導、または CI 統合型の動画パイプラインを構築する開発者やチームに適していると考えられます。Remotion の React ベースのモデルに対する代替として位置づけられているためですが、これは明示的な主張ではなく慎重な推測です。

content.goal: Paperclip is an open-source Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates teams of AI agents (e.g., OpenClaw, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI) to run business-style workflows. It lets users assign goals, track work and costs, and manage agent permissions and history from one dashboard.
content.usage: Install with `npx paperclipai@latest onboard --yes` (requires Node.js 24.11+), or clone the repository and run `pnpm install` and `pnpm dev`, which starts the UI and API at http://localhost:3100 with an embedded PostgreSQL database created automatically.
content.pros: Documented features include company/agent/project budgets with threshold alerts, configurable approval and governance stages, atomic task checkout to prevent duplicate agent runs, and support for multiple organizations within one deployment.
content.cons: Source-based setup requires Node.js 24.11+ and pnpm 9.15+, and building the native Paperclip Runner needs a Rust toolchain unless a prebuilt binary is supplied via PAPERCLIP_RUNNER_BINARY; usage telemetry is also enabled by default, though it can be disabled.
content.fit: The README positions Paperclip for teams coordinating multiple AI agents toward shared goals with budget and governance needs, rather than as an agent-building framework, chatbot, workflow builder, or prompt manager.

It can be installed as a Claude Cowork plugin or deployed via the Claude Managed Agents API, using the same system prompt and skills in either case.

Outputs are also positioned as draft work product requiring review by a qualified professional before use.

content.goal: Hindsight is an agent memory system intended to help AI agents learn over time rather than only recall conversation history. The README reports state-of-the-art results on the LongMemEval benchmark, with performance data independently reproduced by Virginia Tech's Sanghani Center and The Washington Post.
content.usage: Hindsight can be started via Docker (`docker run -it --pull always --name hindsight --restart unless-stopped -p 8888:8888 -p 9999:9999 ghcr.io/vectorize-io/hindsight:latest`), pip (`pip install hindsight-api`), Helm/Kubernetes, or the managed Hindsight Cloud. Clients in Python, Node.js, Go, CLI, or REST connect and call operations like `client.retain()`, `client.recall()`, and `client.reflect()`.
content.pros: It documents support for 25+ LLM providers and 60+ integrations spanning coding agents, agent frameworks, and no-code tools. It also lists multilingual handling and an opt-in Memory Defense feature that scans retained content for secrets and PII; these appear to be documented capabilities rather than independently verified by us.
content.cons: Deployment requires supplying an LLM API key and, for self-hosted setups, storage such as PostgreSQL or Oracle AI Database. Intel-based Macs reportedly need a separate `hindsight-all-slim` package for bare-metal installs, which suggests platform support is not fully uniform across architectures.
content.fit: The README positions Hindsight for agents handling open-ended tasks and learning from feedback, such as AI employees, while noting it may be excessive for simpler workflows built with tools like n8n — suggesting it best suits more complex, long-running agent use cases.

content.goal: security-audit is a skill that turns a coding agent into a security auditor, running audits through six phases: reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. It is the single-repo starting point from which Cloudflare's multi-stage vulnerability discovery harness evolved.
content.usage: Install via the Skills CLI with `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` (add `--global` for a user-level install). Inside the codebase to audit, ask the coding agent to run a request such as `security audit this codebase`; an unspecified output directory defaults to `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`.
content.pros: The workflow uses adversarial validation, where the agent that verifies a finding is never the one that found it, and produces three distinct verdicts (confirmed, needs_validation, rejected) validated against a schema. Cloudflare's test runs reportedly found a single run caught roughly half the vulnerabilities that repeated runs found in total, since ledgers and findings are additive across runs.
content.cons: Executing target code (builds, tests, fuzzers) requires an OS-enforced sandbox that disables external networking, uses a sanitized allowlisted environment, enforces resource limits, and restricts writes to scratch paths; without it, leads reportedly stay marked needs_validation rather than being executed. This suggests full use of the skill may be difficult without existing sandbox infrastructure.
content.fit: Given the sandboxing, Node.js, and parallel-sub-agent model requirements, the skill seems best suited to teams already using capable coding agents and willing to invest in isolated execution environments, rather than serving as a lightweight, drop-in audit tool.

ko.goal: security-audit는 코딩 에이전트를 보안 감사자로 전환시키는 스킬로, 정찰, 커버리지 기반 탐색, 후보 검증, 구조화된 출력, 독립적 기록 검증, 대상 중립적 보고의 6단계로 감사를 수행합니다. 이는 Cloudflare의 다단계 취약점 탐지 하니스가 발전해 나온 단일 저장소 출발점입니다.
ko.usage: Skills CLI로 `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` 명령으로 설치합니다(사용자 수준 설치는 `--global` 추가). 그런 다음 감사할 코드베이스 안에서 코딩 에이전트에게 `security audit this codebase`와 같은 요청을 하면 되며, 출력 디렉터리를 지정하지 않으면 기본값은 `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`입니다.

zh-CN.goal: security-audit 是一个把编码代理变成安全审计员的技能，通过六个阶段进行审计：侦察、基于覆盖率的猎寻、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和目标中立的报告。它是 Cloudflare 多阶段漏洞发现框架演化而来的单仓库起点。
zh-CN.usage: 通过 Skills CLI 使用命令 `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` 安装（添加 `--global` 可进行用户级安装）。然后在要审计的代码库中，让编码代理执行类似 `security audit this codebase` 的请求；若未指定输出目录，默认路径为 `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`。
zh-CN.pros: 该流程采用对抗式验证，核实发现的代理绝不是发现该问题的代理，并生成 confirmed、needs_validation、rejected 三种不同判定结果，并按照模式进行校验。据报告，Cloudflare 的测试运行中，单次运行仅发现了多次重复运行总共发现漏洞数量的大约一半。
zh-CN.cons: 要实际执行目标代码（构建、测试、模糊测试等），需要一个操作系统级沙箱，该沙箱要禁用外部联网、使用经过清理的白名单环境、强制资源限制，并仅允许写入指定的临时路径；据说如果缺少这些控制，相关线索会保持在 needs_validation 状态而不会被执行。这似乎意味着，对于没有现成沙箱基础设施的团队，可能难以完整使用该技能。
zh-CN.fit: 考虑到对沙箱、Node.js 以及支持并行子代理的模型等要求，该技能似乎更适合已经使用具备相应能力的编码代理、并愿意投入搭建隔离执行环境的团队，而不太像是一个轻量级的即插即用审计工具。

es.goal: security-audit es una skill que convierte a un agente de codificación en un auditor de seguridad, ejecutando la auditoría en seis fases: reconocimiento, búsqueda guiada por cobertura, validación de candidatos, salida estructurada, verificación independiente de registros y reporte neutral respecto al objetivo. Es el punto de partida de un solo repositorio a partir del cual evolucionó el sistema de descubrimiento de vulnerabilidades de Cloudflare.
es.usage: Se instala con la Skills CLI mediante `npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` (añadiendo `--global` para una instalación a nivel de usuario). Luego, dentro del código a auditar, se le pide al agente algo como `security audit this codebase`; si no se indica un directorio de salida, el valor predeterminado es `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>`.
es.pros: El flujo utiliza validación adversarial, en la que el agente que verifica un hallazgo nunca es el mismo que lo encontró, y produce tres veredictos distintos (confirmed, needs_validation, rejected) validados contra un esquema. Según las pruebas de Cloudflare, una sola ejecución encontró aproximadamente la mitad de las vulnerabilidades que se hallaron en total tras ejecuciones repetidas.
es.cons: Ejecutar código del objetivo (compilaciones, pruebas, fuzzers) requiere un sandbox reforzado por el sistema operativo que deshabilite el acceso a redes externas, use un entorno restringido mediante lista blanca, aplique límites de recursos y solo permita escritura en rutas temporales asignadas; sin estos controles, según se indica, los hallazgos permanecen marcados como needs_validation en lugar de ejecutarse. Esto sugiere que podría ser difícil aprovechar la skill por completo sin una infraestructura de sandboxing ya existente.
es.fit: Dados los requisitos de sandboxing, Node.js y modelos que soporten subagentes en paralelo, la skill parece estar orientada a equipos que ya usan agentes de codificación capaces y están dispuestos a invertir en entornos de ejecución aislados, más que a ser una herramienta de auditoría ligera y lista para usar.

ja.goal: security-audit は、コーディングエージェントをセキュリティ監査者に変えるスキルで、偵察、カバレッジ主導のハンティング、候補の検証、構造化された出力、独立した記録検証、対象に中立なレポート作成という6段階で監査を実行します。これは Cloudflare のマルチステージ脆弱性発見ハーネスが発展する元となった、単一リポジトリの出発点です。
ja.usage: Skills CLI を使い、`npx skills add https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill --skill security-audit` コマンドでインストールします（ユーザーレベルでのインストールには `--global` を追加）。その後、監査対象のコードベース内でコーディングエージェントに `security audit this codebase` のような指示を出します。出力先ディレクトリを指定しない場合、デフォルトは `~/security-audit-skill/<repo-name>/run-<N>` になります。
ja.pros: このワークフローは敵対的検証を採用しており、発見結果を検証するエージェントは発見したエージェントとは異なり、confirmed、needs_validation、rejected という3種類の判定をスキーマに従って出力します。Cloudflare のテスト実行では、1回の実行で発見された脆弱性は、複数回の実行を合計して発見された数のおよそ半分だったと報告されています。
ja.cons: ビルド、テスト、ファジングなど対象コードを実際に実行するには、外部ネットワークを無効化し、許可リスト化されたサニタイズ済み環境を使い、リソース制限を適用し、スクラッチパスへの書き込みのみを許可する OS レベルのサンドボックスが必要とされており、これがない場合、該当するリードは実行されずに needs_validation のままになるとされています。このことから、既存のサンドボックス基盤がないチームにとっては、このスキルを十分に活用しにくい可能性があります。
ja.fit: サンドボックス、Node.js、並列サブエージェントに対応したモデルといった要件を踏まえると、このスキルは軽量な即利用型の監査ツールというよりも、すでに十分な能力を持つコーディングエージェントを使い、分離された実行環境の構築に投資する意思があるチームに向いていると考えられます。

content.goal: Agent Substrate is a zero-trust, security-hardened runtime for sandboxing agent workloads on Kubernetes, built to run large numbers of agents with higher density than standard containers.
content.usage: Development setup runs `hack/create-kind-cluster.sh` to create a local kind cluster, then `hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-ate-system --credential-provider='{"name":"k8s.io"}'` to install the Agent Substrate system; a `kubectl-ate` CLI is then used to create and manage actors.
content.pros: The README reports resume operations under 400ms, more than 1500 activations per second, and up to 10x higher density than standard containers through actor multiplexing. It also describes default-deny networking and keeps credentials out of the sandbox via an egress gateway.
content.cons: The project is explicitly pre-1.0, so APIs and behavior may still change significantly without backward-compatibility guarantees. Plain Linux containers are also not supported; every actor appears to require a gVisor or microVM sandbox, which could add operational overhead for adopters.
content.fit: Agent Substrate seems best suited for teams running many untrusted, mostly-idle AI agent workloads on Kubernetes that need strong isolation, rather than as a general-purpose container platform for arbitrary workloads.

ko.goal: Agent Substrate는 Kubernetes에서 에이전트 워크로드를 샌드박싱하기 위한 제로 트러스트 기반의 보안 강화 런타임으로, 표준 컨테이너보다 높은 밀도로 많은 수의 에이전트를 실행하도록 설계되었습니다.
ko.usage: 개발 환경 설정은 `hack/create-kind-cluster.sh`를 실행해 로컬 kind 클러스터를 생성한 뒤, `hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-ate-system --credential-provider='{"name":"k8s.io"}'`로 Agent Substrate 시스템을 설치합니다. 이후 `kubectl-ate` CLI를 사용해 액터를 생성하고 관리합니다.
ko.pros: README에 따르면 재개 작업은 400ms 이내, 초당 1500회 이상의 활성화를 지원하며, 액터 멀티플렉싱을 통해 표준 컨테이너보다 최대 10x 높은 밀도를 달성한다고 설명합니다. 또한 기본 거부(default-deny) 네트워킹을 적용하고 egress 게이트웨이를 통해 자격 증명을 샌드박스 밖에 유지합니다.
ko.cons: 이 프로젝트는 명시적으로 pre-1.0 단계이므로 하위 호환성이 보장되지 않고 API와 동작이 크게 바뀔 수 있습니다. 또한 일반 Linux 컨테이너는 지원되지 않는 것으로 보이며, 모든 액터는 gVisor 또는 microVM 샌드박스를 요구하는 듯해 도입 시 운영 부담이 늘어날 수 있습니다.
ko.fit: Agent Substrate는 강력한 격리가 필요한, 신뢰할 수 없고 대부분 유휴 상태인 AI 에이전트 워크로드를 Kubernetes에서 다수 운영하는 팀에 적합해 보이며, 범용 컨테이너 플랫폼으로는 적합하지 않을 수 있습니다.

es.goal: Agent Substrate es un runtime de confianza cero y reforzado en seguridad para aislar cargas de trabajo de agentes en Kubernetes, diseñado para ejecutar un gran número de agentes con mayor densidad que los contenedores estándar.
es.usage: La configuración de desarrollo ejecuta `hack/create-kind-cluster.sh` para crear un clúster kind local y luego `hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-ate-system --credential-provider='{"name":"k8s.io"}'` para instalar el sistema Agent Substrate; después se usa la CLI `kubectl-ate` para crear y gestionar actores.
es.pros: El README indica que las operaciones de reanudación tardan menos de 400ms, con más de 1500 activaciones por segundo, y hasta 10x más densidad que los contenedores estándar mediante multiplexación de actores. También describe redes con denegación por defecto y credenciales mantenidas fuera del sandbox a través de una puerta de enlace de salida.
es.cons: El proyecto está explícitamente en estado pre-1.0, por lo que no hay garantías de compatibilidad hacia atrás y las APIs y el comportamiento podrían cambiar significativamente. Además, los contenedores Linux normales no parecen estar soportados; cada actor parece requerir un sandbox gVisor o microVM, lo que podría añadir carga operativa para quienes lo adopten.
es.fit: Agent Substrate parece adecuado para equipos que ejecutan muchas cargas de trabajo de agentes de IA no confiables y mayormente inactivas en Kubernetes que necesitan un aislamiento fuerte, más que como una plataforma de contenedores de uso general.

ja.goal: Agent Substrateは、Kubernetes上でエージェントのワークロードをサンドボックス化するためのゼロトラストなセキュリティ強化ランタイムで、標準コンテナよりも高い密度で多数のエージェントを実行することを目指しています。
ja.usage: 開発環境のセットアップでは、まず`hack/create-kind-cluster.sh`を実行してローカルのkindクラスタを作成し、次に`hack/install-ate-kind.sh --deploy-ate-system --credential-provider='{"name":"k8s.io"}'`でAgent Substrateシステムをインストールします。その後`kubectl-ate` CLIを使ってアクターを作成・管理します。
ja.pros: READMEによると、レジューム処理は400ms未満で完了し、1秒あたり1500回を超えるアクティベーションに対応し、アクターの多重化により標準コンテナと比べて最大10倍の密度を実現するとされています。また、デフォルト拒否のネットワーキングと、egressゲートウェイを介して資格情報をサンドボックス外に保持する仕組みも説明されています。
ja.cons: このプロジェクトは明確にpre-1.0段階にあり、後方互換性の保証はなく、APIや動作が大きく変わる可能性があります。また、通常のLinuxコンテナはサポートされていないようで、各アクターはgVisorまたはmicroVMサンドボックスを必要とするように見えるため、導入時に運用上の負担が増える可能性があります。
ja.fit: Agent Substrateは、強力な分離が必要な、信頼できずほとんどアイドル状態のAIエージェントワークロードをKubernetes上で多数運用するチームに適していると思われ、汎用的なコンテナプラットフォームとしての用途には向いていない可能性があります。

content.goal: OpenShell is a runtime designed to let fleets of autonomous AI agents read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials under an administrator-declared policy, aiming to constrain agent access to data, secrets, and network resources rather than grant unrestricted access.
content.usage: Setup starts with `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh`, which installs the CLI and a local gateway; `openshell sandbox create --name demo` then creates a sandbox, though the default image ships with no agent installed.
content.pros: Enforcement happens at the kernel level, confining file access and system calls per sandbox and routing every network connection through a policy check, while agents never see raw credentials since OpenShell injects them only for requests to approved endpoints. Policy changes also undergo formal verification before approval, flagging risky new access such as new hosts or API methods for human review.
content.cons: Running OpenShell requires Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, or Windows with WSL 2, which is explicitly marked experimental, plus Docker, Podman, or host virtualization, suggesting platform support may still be maturing on some systems.
content.fit: Given the 0.1.x release is described as introducing a new stable release cadence alongside new isolation primitives and APIs, OpenShell appears best suited for teams just adopting policy-governed agent sandboxes rather than those needing a long-established, fully mature tool.

ko.goal: OpenShell는 자율 AI 에이전트 플릿이 관리자가 선언한 정책에 따라 파일 읽기, 패키지 설치, API 호출, 자격 증명 사용을 할 수 있도록 하는 런타임으로, 무제한 접근을 허용하는 대신 데이터·비밀·네트워크에 대한 에이전트 접근을 제한하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
ko.usage: 설치는 `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh` 명령으로 CLI와 로컬 게이트웨이를 설치하는 것으로 시작하며, 이어서 `openshell sandbox create --name demo` 명령으로 샌드박스를 생성합니다. 기본 이미지에는 에이전트가 설치되어 있지 않습니다.
ko.pros: 커널 수준에서 각 샌드박스의 파일 접근과 시스템 호출을 제한하고 모든 네트워크 연결이 정책 검사를 거치며, 에이전트는 원본 자격 증명을 직접 보지 못하고 승인된 엔드포인트로 가는 요청에만 자격 증명이 주입됩니다. 또한 정책 변경은 승인 전에 정형 검증을 거쳐 새 호스트 접근이나 새 API 호출 같은 위험 요소를 사람이 검토하도록 표시합니다.

zh-CN.goal: OpenShell 是一个运行时,旨在让自治 AI 代理群组按照管理员声明的策略读取文件、安装软件包、调用 API 和使用凭据,从而限制代理对数据、密钥和网络的访问,而不是赋予其不受限制的访问权限。
zh-CN.usage: 安装从执行 `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh` 开始,该命令会安装 CLI 和本地网关;随后使用 `openshell sandbox create --name demo` 创建沙箱。默认镜像不包含任何已安装的代理。
zh-CN.pros: 内核级机制限制每个沙箱可访问的文件和可执行的系统调用,并对每个网络连接进行策略检查,代理本身不会看到真实凭据,凭据仅在请求发往已批准的端点时才被注入。此外,策略变更在获批前会经过形式化验证,标记出诸如访问新主机或调用新 API 方法等风险访问,交由人工审核。
zh-CN.cons: 运行需要 Linux、Apple Silicon 版 macOS,或带 WSL 2(实验性支持)的 Windows,并需配合 Docker、Podman 或主机虚拟化,这表明在部分平台上的支持可能仍不够成熟。
zh-CN.fit: 文档将 0.1.x 描述为引入了新的稳定发布节奏、隔离机制和扩展 API,这似乎更适合刚开始采用基于策略的代理沙箱的团队,而非需要长期成熟工具的团队。

es.goal: OpenShell es un entorno de ejecución pensado para que flotas de agentes de IA autónomos lean archivos, instalen paquetes, llamen a APIs y usen credenciales según una política declarada por el administrador, con el objetivo de limitar el acceso de los agentes a datos, secretos y red en lugar de otorgar acceso sin restricciones.
es.usage: La instalación comienza ejecutando `curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh`, que instala la CLI y un gateway local; luego `openshell sandbox create --name demo` crea un sandbox. La imagen de sandbox predeterminada no incluye ningún agente instalado.
es.pros: La aplicación a nivel de kernel limita qué archivos y llamadas al sistema puede usar cada sandbox, y cada conexión de red pasa por una verificación de política; los agentes nunca ven las credenciales reales, que OpenShell solo inyecta en solicitudes dirigidas a endpoints aprobados. Además, los cambios de política pasan por verificación formal antes de aprobarse, señalando accesos riesgosos nuevos, como un host nuevo o un método de API nuevo, para revisión humana.
es.cons: Ejecutarlo requiere Linux, macOS en Apple Silicon, o Windows con WSL 2 (marcado como experimental), junto con Docker, Podman o virtualización de host, lo que sugiere que el soporte en algunas plataformas aún podría estar madurando.
es.fit: Dado que la versión 0.1.x se describe como la introducción de una nueva cadencia de lanzamientos estables junto con nuevas primitivas de aislamiento y APIs, OpenShell parece más adecuado para equipos que recién adoptan sandboxes de agentes gobernados por políticas que para quienes buscan una herramienta ya muy madura.

ja.goal: OpenShellは、自律的なAIエージェント群が管理者が宣言したポリシーに従ってファイルの読み取り、パッケージのインストール、API呼び出し、資格情報の利用を行えるようにするランタイムで、無制限のアクセスを与える代わりにデータ・シークレット・ネットワークへのアクセスを制限することを目的としています。

content.goal: ECC (affaan-m/ECC) is an open-source, MIT-licensed agent harness system that gives coding agents a structured engineering workflow: plan, test, implement, review, verify, remember, improve, instead of rebuilding that process in every prompt.
content.usage: The recommended install runs `npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup` for guided Claude Code plugin setup; Claude Code's native commands `/plugin marketplace add https://github.com/affaan-m/ECC` and `/plugin install ecc@ecc` are a documented alternative path.
content.pros: The package bundles 71 specialized agents, 311 reusable skills, and 97 legacy command shims, plus hooks, rules, memory, continuous learning, and AgentShield security scanning for agent configurations.
content.cons: Setup documents concrete prerequisites: the universal package needs Node.js 18 or newer, and the Claude plugin path additionally requires Git and Claude Code 2.1 or newer on PATH; some optional features, such as a macOS GAN shell path incompatible with the system Bash 3.2 and certain Windows-native memory-vault writes, are noted as having open defects.
content.fit: The README states ECC works best with Claude Code today, with native plugin paths for Codex and Qoder; other harnesses such as Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini, Zed, GitHub Copilot, Antigravity, and Qwen only get capability-limited adapters, so it may be worth checking the support-status matrix before assuming full feature parity.

content.goal: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source, self-hosted router that aggregates free tiers from 34 LLM providers into one OpenAI-compatible `/v1` API, giving access to roughly 7.4 billion tokens per month across 474 model families and 635 free endpoints.
content.usage: Install via the one-liner `curl -fsSL https://freellmapi.co/install.sh | bash` (Docker required), which sets up a local instance and starts the container. Add provider keys from the dashboard at http://localhost:3001 and point any OpenAI-compatible client at the unified key; coding agents can be configured with commands like `npx freellmapi setup-claude`.
content.pros: Documented features include OpenAI, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini/Ollama-compatible endpoints, automatic fallover between providers, per-key usage tracking to stay under free-tier caps, AES-256-GCM encrypted key storage, and a self-updating model catalog, running on Node 20+ across Windows/macOS/Linux with low memory use.
content.cons: Free installs appear to receive the model catalog as a monthly snapshot rather than the live daily feed, so a model reportedly takes about 30 days to appear after release and the free build is currently roughly 303 models behind; the documented limitations also note no frontier models, variable latency, no SLA, and reduced effective capacity late in the day as provider caps are reached.
content.fit: The documentation frames the project as intended for personal experimentation and learning rather than production, suggesting it may suit individual prototyping or hobbyist self-hosting better than mission-critical deployments.

zh-CN.usage: 通过需要 Docker 的一键命令 `curl -fsSL https://freellmapi.co/install.sh | bash` 安装,该命令会设置本地实例并启动容器。随后在仪表盘(http://localhost:3001)添加提供商密钥,并将统一密钥提供给任意兼容 OpenAI 的客户端;编码代理可通过如 `npx freellmapi setup-claude` 等命令进行配置。
zh-CN.pros: 据文档描述,该项目支持 OpenAI、Anthropic Messages 及 Gemini/Ollama 兼容端点、提供商间自动故障转移、按密钥追踪用量以保持在免费额度内、采用 AES-256-GCM 加密存储密钥,并具备自动更新的模型目录,可在 Node 20+ 环境下于 Windows/macOS/Linux 轻量运行。

es.goal: FreeLLMAPI es un enrutador autoalojado y de código abierto que agrega los niveles gratuitos de 34 proveedores de LLM en una única API compatible con OpenAI (`/v1`), con acceso a unos 7.4 billion de tokens gratuitos al mes repartidos entre 474 familias de modelos y 635 endpoints gratuitos.
es.usage: Se instala con el comando único `curl -fsSL https://freellmapi.co/install.sh | bash` (requiere Docker), que configura una instancia local e inicia el contenedor. Luego se añaden las claves de los proveedores desde el panel en http://localhost:3001 y se usa la clave unificada en cualquier cliente compatible con OpenAI; los agentes de codificación pueden configurarse con comandos como `npx freellmapi setup-claude`.
es.pros: Según la documentación, ofrece endpoints compatibles con OpenAI, Anthropic Messages y Gemini/Ollama, conmutación automática por error entre proveedores, seguimiento de uso por clave para no superar los límites gratuitos, claves cifradas con AES-256-GCM, y un catálogo de modelos autoactualizable; funciona en Node 20+ sobre Windows/macOS/Linux con bajo consumo de memoria.
es.cons: Las instalaciones gratuitas parecen recibir el catálogo mediante una instantánea mensual en lugar del feed diario en vivo, por lo que un modelo tardaría unos 30 días en llegar tras publicarse, quedando actualmente unos 303 modelos por detrás. La sección de limitaciones documentada también señala ausencia de modelos de frontera, latencia variable, falta de SLA, y una posible caída de la capacidad efectiva al final del día cuando los proveedores agotan sus cuotas diarias.
es.fit: La documentación describe el proyecto como pensado para 'experimentación personal y aprendizaje', no para producción, lo que sugiere que podría encajar mejor en prototipos individuales o en autoalojamiento como afición que en despliegues críticos.

ja.goal: FreeLLMAPIは、34のLLMプロバイダーの無料枠を1つのOpenAI互換`/v1`APIに集約するオープンソースのセルフホスト型ルーターであり、474のモデルファミリーと635の無料エンドポイントにまたがり月間約7.4 billionトークン相当の無料推論能力へのアクセスを提供します。

content.goal: Knowledge Work Plugins packages skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents into 11 role-specific plugins (e.g., sales, finance, legal, data) that aim to turn Claude into a specialist for a given job function, built for Claude Cowork and also compatible with Claude Code.

content.pros: Each plugin bundles domain skills that Claude draws on automatically, explicit slash commands, and MCP connectors to external tools; every component is file-based (markdown and JSON), requiring no code, infrastructure, or build steps.

content.fit: Appears suited to teams or companies wanting to tailor Claude to their own tools, terminology, and processes across functions like sales, finance, legal, or data, using Claude Cowork or Claude Code.

content.goal: The project is a free, MIT-licensed curriculum for implementing AI model internals, retrieval pipelines, and agent runtimes. It is organized into 542 lessons across 20 phases, with code in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia.
content.usage: Two main paths are documented: cloning the repository and running `git clone https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.git` followed by `python3 phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment/code/verify.py --route beginner`, or installing it as a coding-agent skill with `npx skills add rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch` and invoking `start-learning` in the chosen host.
content.pros: It is free and open source, and every lesson is documented to produce a reusable artifact (a prompt, skill, agent, or MCP server) rather than ending at a concept. The curriculum spans a broad range, from math foundations to production infrastructure and multi-agent systems.
content.cons: The AI-tutor/skills workflow depends on having Node.js, npx, python3, and a compatible coding-agent host; the README notes that without these, real-host discovery, invocation, and uninstall evidence 'remains pending,' which suggests the skill-based path may be less reliable to verify outside a supported agent environment.
content.fit: Given the prerequisite that users should already be able to write code and want to understand AI internals rather than just call APIs, this seems best suited to learners with some programming background. Estimated study time ranges from about 306 hours for complete beginners to roughly 60 hours for engineers focused only on agent engineering, implying it fits those able to commit significant time.

ko.usage: 문서에는 두 가지 주요 방법이 나와 있습니다. 저장소를 클론한 뒤 `git clone https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.git`와 `python3 phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment/code/verify.py --route beginner`를 실행하는 방법, 또는 `npx skills add rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch`로 코딩 에이전트 스킬로 설치한 뒤 선택한 호스트에서 `start-learning`을 호출하는 방법입니다.
ko.pros: 무료이며 오픈소스이고, 문서에 따르면 각 레슨이 프롬프트, 스킬, 에이전트, MCP 서버 같은 재사용 가능한 결과물을 만들어낸다고 설명되어 있어 단순 개념 학습에 그치지 않습니다. 수학 기초부터 프로덕션 인프라와 멀티에이전트 시스템까지 폭넓은 범위를 다룹니다.

ko.fit: 이미 코드를 작성할 수 있고 단순히 API를 호출하는 것이 아니라 AI 내부 동작을 이해하고 싶은 사용자를 전제로 하므로, 어느 정도 프로그래밍 경험이 있는 학습자에게 적합한 것으로 보입니다. 예상 학습 시간은 완전 초보자의 경우 약 306시간, 에이전트 엔지니어링만 다루는 숙련 엔지니어의 경우 약 60시간으로, 상당한 시간을 투자할 수 있는 사람에게 맞을 것으로 추정됩니다.

es.usage: Se documentan dos vías principales: clonar el repositorio y ejecutar `git clone https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.git` seguido de `python3 phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment/code/verify.py --route beginner`, o instalarlo como habilidad de agente de código con `npx skills add rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch` e invocar `start-learning` en el host elegido.
es.pros: Es gratuito y de código abierto, y según la documentación cada lección produce un artefacto reutilizable (un prompt, una skill, un agente o un servidor MCP) en lugar de quedarse solo en la teoría. El temario abarca un rango amplio, desde fundamentos matemáticos hasta infraestructura de producción y sistemas multiagente.
es.cons: El flujo de tutor de IA/skills depende de tener Node.js, npx, python3 y un host de agente de código compatible; el README indica que, sin esto, la evidencia de descubrimiento, invocación y desinstalación en un host real 'queda pendiente', lo que sugiere que la vía basada en skills podría ser más difícil de verificar fuera de un entorno de agente compatible.
es.fit: Dado que se presupone que el usuario ya sabe programar y busca entender el funcionamiento interno de la IA en lugar de solo llamar a APIs, parece más adecuado para quienes tienen cierta base de programación. El tiempo de estudio estimado va desde unas 306 horas para principiantes totales hasta unas 60 horas para ingenieros centrados solo en la ingeniería de agentes, lo que indica que conviene a quienes pueden dedicar un tiempo considerable.

ja.usage: ドキュメントには2つの主な方法が記載されています。リポジトリをクローンして `git clone https://github.com/rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch.git` と `python3 phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-environment/code/verify.py --route beginner` を実行する方法、または `npx skills add rohitg00/ai-engineering-from-scratch` でコーディングエージェントのスキルとしてインストールし、選択したホストで `start-learning` を呼び出す方法です。

content.goal: Cua is a repository providing tools for AI agents to control computers. It includes Cua Spaces (full macOS/Linux desktops on machines you own), Cua Driver (desktop automation for macOS, Windows, and Linux), Lume (local macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon), CUA-S1 (small decision models for computer use), and Cua Bench (agent evaluation and trajectory export).
content.usage: Install the SDK and CLI with `curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/install.sh | sh` on macOS/Linux, then create a sandbox with `cua sb create ubuntu --name dev` and run commands such as `cua sb exec dev uname -a`.

content.cons: Cua Spaces and Cua Driver Bench are source-available under FSL-1.1-MIT rather than a fully open license, and paid tiers cost $18/month (Pro) or $30/seat/month (Teams); separately, the deprecated `cuabot` package is flagged with known security issues and documented as something not to run.

content.goal: GPUI Kit is a Rust desktop application framework built on GPUI, combining a production-ready UI system with data, layout, and editing capabilities. It ships 75+ documented components, WebAssembly support, AccessKit accessibility, UI integration testing, and an optional JavaScript extension runtime. Documentation is at https://gpui-kit.com.
content.usage: Add gpui-kit = "0.7" to a Rust project's Cargo.toml dependencies to pull in GPUI plus the base and component layers. AI coding agent skills can be installed with npx skills add longbridge/gpui-kit, and a bundled gallery app can be run via cargo run.
content.pros: The toolkit lists 75+ components covering forms, navigation, overlays, and editing, plus 120 FPS GPU-accelerated rendering, virtualized data tables and lists, a code editor with Tree-sitter and LSP support, serializable dock layouts, and native Markdown/HTML rendering with built-in charts.
content.cons: By default, gpui-kit enables the gpui-component layer and bundled icon set, so applications that only need gpui-base's unstyled behavior must explicitly turn off default features to avoid pulling in the full styled UI system.
content.fit: It appears suited to Rust developers building cross-platform (macOS, Windows, Linux) desktop applications who want a production-tested UI framework, as it reportedly powers the commercial Longbridge Pro application.

zh-CN.goal: GPUI Kit 是一个基于 GPUI 构建的 Rust 桌面应用框架,将生产级 UI 系统与数据、布局和编辑能力结合在一起。它提供 75 个以上有文档记录的组件、WebAssembly 支持、AccessKit 无障碍功能、UI 集成测试,以及可选的 JavaScript 扩展运行时。文档位于 https://gpui-kit.com。
zh-CN.usage: 在 Rust 项目的 Cargo.toml 中添加依赖 gpui-kit = "0.7",即可引入 GPUI 以及 base/component 层。可以通过 npx skills add longbridge/gpui-kit 为 AI 编码代理安装相关技能,并使用 cargo run 运行内置的展示应用。

es.goal: GPUI Kit es un framework de aplicaciones de escritorio en Rust construido sobre GPUI, que combina un sistema de UI listo para producción con capacidades de datos, diseño y edición. Incluye más de 75 componentes documentados, soporte para WebAssembly, accesibilidad mediante AccessKit, pruebas de integración de UI y un runtime opcional de extensiones en JavaScript. La documentación está en https://gpui-kit.com.
es.usage: Para usarlo, se añade la dependencia gpui-kit = "0.7" al Cargo.toml de un proyecto Rust, lo que incorpora GPUI junto con las capas base y component. Las habilidades para agentes de codificación con IA se instalan con npx skills add longbridge/gpui-kit, y la aplicación de galería incluida se ejecuta con cargo run.
es.pros: El kit ofrece más de 75 componentes para formularios, navegación, superposiciones y edición, junto con renderizado acelerado por GPU a 120 FPS, tablas y listas de datos virtualizadas, un editor de código con soporte de Tree-sitter y LSP, diseños de dock serializables, y renderizado nativo de Markdown/HTML con gráficos integrados.
es.cons: De forma predeterminada, gpui-kit activa la capa gpui-component y el conjunto de iconos incluido, por lo que las aplicaciones que solo necesitan el comportamiento sin estilos de gpui-base deben desactivar explícitamente las características predeterminadas para no incorporar todo el sistema de UI con estilo.
es.fit: Según el repositorio, impulsa la aplicación comercial Longbridge Pro, por lo que parece adecuado para desarrolladores Rust que buscan construir aplicaciones de escritorio multiplataforma (macOS, Windows, Linux) con un framework de UI probado en producción.

content.goal: T3 Code is presented as an "agent harness control surface" that lets a user control coding agents running on their own machine—Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity—through a mobile app, web app, or desktop app.
content.usage: On macOS/Linux it installs via `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh` (a PowerShell equivalent is provided for Windows); afterward, running `t3` starts the server and opens the local web app. To try it once without installing, `npx t3@latest` can be run. The desktop app is also available from GitHub Releases or via package managers such as winget, scoop, brew, apt, or AUR.
content.pros: The README states the project is not commercial and was built to be open so it can be forked, and it works with agent subscriptions a user already has installed and authenticated on their machine.
content.cons: The documentation describes the project as very early, with bugs expected, and the maintainers state they are mostly not accepting large contributions yet. In addition, at least one supported agent provider must be separately installed and authenticated before T3 Code can be used.
content.fit: Based on this information, T3 Code appears best suited for developers who already use one or more of the listed agent CLIs and want a single, potentially remote, interface to manage them across devices.

zh-CN.usage: 在 macOS/Linux 上可通过 `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh` 安装（Windows 使用对应的 PowerShell 命令），安装后运行 `t3` 即可启动服务器并打开本地网页应用；若只想试用一次,可运行 `npx t3@latest`。桌面应用也可从 GitHub Releases 或通过 winget、scoop、brew、apt、AUR 等包管理器安装。
zh-CN.pros: README 说明该项目不以盈利为目的，并以开放方式构建以便用户可以自行分叉,同时它可以配合用户电脑上已安装并完成身份验证的代理订阅使用。
zh-CN.cons: 文档说明该项目处于非常早期阶段,预计会存在漏洞,维护者表示目前基本不接受较大的贡献。此外,在使用 T3 Code 之前,必须单独安装并验证至少一个受支持的代理提供方。
zh-CN.fit: 根据这些信息推测,T3 Code 似乎更适合那些已经在使用上述某个代理 CLI 工具、并希望通过单一的、可能支持远程访问的界面在多个设备上统一控制这些代理的开发者。

es.goal: T3 Code se presenta como una 'superficie de control de agentes' que permite controlar agentes de codificación que se ejecutan en el propio equipo —Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode y Google Antigravity— desde una app móvil, una app web o una app de escritorio.
es.usage: En macOS/Linux se instala con `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh` (en Windows se usa el comando equivalente de PowerShell); después, ejecutar `t3` inicia el servidor y abre la app web local. Para probarlo una vez sin instalar, se puede ejecutar `npx t3@latest`. La app de escritorio también está disponible en GitHub Releases o mediante gestores de paquetes como winget, scoop, brew, apt o AUR.
es.pros: Según el README, el proyecto no tiene fines comerciales y se construyó de forma abierta para poder bifurcarse, y funciona con las suscripciones de agentes que el usuario ya tenga instaladas y autenticadas en su equipo.
es.cons: La documentación indica que el proyecto está en una etapa muy temprana y se esperan errores, y los mantenedores señalan que por ahora casi no se aceptan contribuciones grandes. Además, antes de usar T3 Code es necesario instalar y autenticar por separado al menos uno de los proveedores de agentes admitidos.
es.fit: Con base en esta información, T3 Code parece estar pensado para desarrolladores que ya utilizan alguno de los CLI de agentes mencionados y desean una interfaz única, posiblemente remota, para controlarlos en varios dispositivos.

ja.goal: T3 Codeは「エージェントハーネス制御サーフェス」として紹介されており、モバイルアプリ、ウェブアプリ、デスクトップアプリから、自分のマシン上で動作するコーディングエージェント（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build、OpenCode、Google Antigravity）を操作できるとされています。
ja.usage: macOS/Linuxでは `curl -fsSL https://t3.codes/install.sh | sh` でインストールし（Windowsでは対応するPowerShellコマンドを使用）、インストール後に `t3` を実行するとサーバーが起動しローカルのウェブアプリが開きます。インストールせずに一度だけ試す場合は `npx t3@latest` を実行できます。デスクトップアプリはGitHub Releasesや、winget、scoop、brew、apt、AURなどのパッケージマネージャからも入手できます。
ja.pros: READMEによれば、このプロジェクトは商業目的ではなく、フォークできるようオープンに構築されており、ユーザーが既にインストールして認証済みのエージェントのサブスクリプションと組み合わせて動作するとされています。
ja.cons: ドキュメントでは、プロジェクトが非常に初期段階にあり不具合が予想されると説明されており、メンテナーは大きな貢献は基本的に受け入れていないとしています。さらに、T3 Codeを使用する前に、サポートされているエージェントプロバイダーのうち少なくとも1つを別途インストールし認証する必要があります。
ja.fit: これらの情報から推測すると、T3 Codeは記載されているエージェントCLIのいずれかを既に使用しており、複数のデバイスから一元的に、場合によってはリモートで制御したいと考える開発者に向いていると考えられます。
